life_cycle='annual' inferred by Ollama; reasoning: Chamomile is typically grown as an annual in home gardens in Belgium, as it completes its life cycle within one growing season.

is_edible corrected from false to true (GitHub issue #165): edible_parts=['leaves', 'flowers'] was already populated, a direct contradiction with is_edible=false, and no is_toxic flag or toxicity_notes explained the discrepancy - a full-dataset audit found this affecting 120 plants (grown from an earlier 25-plant spot-check once backlog #133's edible_parts backfill widened coverage), all of them unambiguous real food/herb/fruit crops.
